name: Valdris
title: The Anvil-Born
fantasy: Walking siege engine. Slow, unkillable, hits like a collapsing temple.
passive: Reforged Flesh: damage taken converts to Armor (max 50% mitigation). When armor breaks, emits a shockwave taunt.
active1: Bulwark Slam: leap-slam, stun + raise a forge barricade that blocks projectiles.
active2: Siege Stance: immobile; fire rate +120%, incoming damage −40%, enemies target you.
ultimate: Mountainfall: become a colossal anvil-avatar for 8s; every shot is an exploding boulder, ground pounds chain.
coop_role: Aggro anchor, protects forge moments, enables glass-cannon teammates.

name: Selene
title: The Stormcaller
fantasy: Lightning in human shape. Deletes screens, dies if touched.
passive: Static Charge: movement builds charge; next Active deals bonus damage and chains.
active1: Arc Nova: chain-lightning burst scaling with weapon fire rate.
active2: Blink: teleport through enemies, leaving a storm trail.
ultimate: Heaven's Verdict: call a moving thunderstorm front that supercharges all allies' projectiles inside it.
coop_role: Wave clear, ultimate battery, the one who ends the boss phase.
skins: Stormcaller; Eye of the Tempest; Skybreaker

name: Kael
title: The Wraithshot
fantasy: Ghost gunslinger. Never stops moving, never misses twice.
passive: Ghost Step: each kill grants a short dash refresh + stacking crit chance (decays).
active1: Fan of Blades: shotgun-like spectral burst, applies Mark (crits on Marked = execute below 15% HP).
active2: Shadow Roll: roll with i-frames, auto-reload and next 3 shots pierce.
ultimate: Bullet Ballet: 6s of infinite dash + twin spectral pistols that copy your current Mechanism.

name: Thessaly
title: The Hexweaver
fantasy: Witch-engineer who turns the battlefield into a cursed machine.
passive: Curse Weaver: debuffed enemies take +25% damage from all allies.
active1: Forge Turret: deploy a turret copying your current weapon's Core + Mechanism at 40% power.
active2: Binding Hex: root field; enemies killed inside drop extra parts.
ultimate: Sabbath of Sparks: all turrets and Echoes gain +200% fire rate; allies gain lifesteal vs cursed targets.
coop_role: Force multiplier, resource engine, area denial.

name: Brax
title: The Furnace-Born
fantasy: Bare-knuckle demigod with forge-gauntlets. For Brax, punching is the build.
passive: Heat Gauge: sustained fire builds Heat; at max, attacks ignite and stagger, and Brax takes reduced burn damage.
active1: Cinder Uppercut: launch enemies skyward, follow-up slam spawns flame geysers.
active2: Furnace Rush: charge through a horde line, dragging enemies with you.
ultimate: Meltdown: 8s of molten fists — melee strikes emit shockwaves that copy your current Mechanism.
coop_role: Crowd control, frontline DPS, pairs with Valdris for unbreakable walls.

name: Ossian
title: The Far-Struck
fantasy: The hunt-god's last archer. Deletes what he can see, helpless when surrounded.
passive: Marked Quarry: damage stacks on a single target; switching targets resets. +30% damage to full-HP enemies.
active1: Piercing Comet: charge shot that penetrates every enemy and wall in a line.
active2: Skyhook Mortar: arcing lob that splits into bomblets on landing.
ultimate: Rain of the Hunt: 5s of auto-crits on every Marked enemy, anywhere on screen.

name: Mirren
title: The Gilded Fox
fantasy: Smiling thief of divine relics. To Mirren, the battlefield is a heist.
passive: Fortune's Favor: +25% part drop quality; chance to duplicate forged parts.
active1: Gilded Decoy: taunting clone that explodes into coins and shrapnel.
active2: Snatch: teleport-strike that steals an elite's buff and applies it to yourself.
ultimate: Grand Heist: 6s where every enemy killed drops bonus loot; all allies' next anvil actions are free.
coop_role: Loot economy, chaos agent, run accelerant.

name: Epoch
title: The Unwound
fantasy: Walked out of a dead god's clock. Decides when things happen.
passive: Borrowed Time: cooldowns tick 40% faster while moving.
active1: Still Field: bubble that slows enemies and projectiles inside.
active2: Rewind Wounds: reverts an ally's damage taken over the last 3s (or your own).
ultimate: Stolen Second: freeze enemies 2s; allies reposition freely; all ally cooldowns reset on expiry.
coop_role: Tempo controller, cooldown battery, clutch saver.

name: Fenra
title: The Huntmother
fantasy: Raised a Chimera-pup on godflesh. It copies whatever she fires.
passive: Pack Bond: your Chimera-pup copies your current Mechanism.
active1: Sic 'Em: send the pup to maul a target.
active2: Den Call: summon a howl that roots nearby enemies.
ultimate: Wild Hunt: the pup grows colossal for 8s.

name: Lyra
title: of the Last Chorus
fantasy: The last voice of a choir that sang the gods to sleep.
passive: Crescendo: damage auras scale with ally kill-streaks.
active1: Hymn of Haste: allies gain fire rate.
ultimate: Last Chorus: every ally's damage is amplified for 8s.

name: Vex
title: The Reddeath
fantasy: Brews apocalypse in glass. Corpses are just unexploded ingredients.
active1: Bottle Toss: lob a spreading plague flask.
active2: Miasma Step: dash leaves a toxic cloud.
ultimate: Red Death: every corpse detonates for 6s.

name: Seraph
title: Heir of Law
fantasy: Carries the verdicts of a god of law who is no longer alive to issue them.
passive: Judgement Marks: marked enemies pay out bonus damage when allies strike them.
active1: Aegis: shield allies in a radius.
ultimate: Verdict: mark every enemy on screen.
